package.description: Uses the OMOTON MK212 accent bar as a Windows disk activity indicator.

en-US.description: Uses the OMOTON MK212 accent bar as a Windows disk activity indicator.
en-US.longDescription: MK212 DriveGlow is a tiny Windows tray application that turns the side light of the OMOTON MK212 keyboard into a classic disk activity indicator. It offers configurable colors, classic flashing or an activity-level display, optional automatic startup, and SignalRGB coexistence guidance. No additional driver, service, or administrator rights are required.
en-US.name: MK212 DriveGlow
